component.name: Easy Player
component.summary: Play a song, then the rest of its folder

description.p: Easy Player is a small audio player. Drop songs or folders on the window, or double-click a song in the file manager, and it plays.
One button brings in the other songs from the playing song's folder, in folder order around it, so an album carries on from the song you opened.

ul.li: Plays MP3, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, WAV, AAC/M4A, AIFF and more
Keyboard media keys and the desktop's media controls (MPRIS)
A song opened from the file manager goes to an idle window, or a new one
One player plays at a time: starting a song pauses the others

screenshot.caption: A folder of songs as a playlist
Drop songs or folders on the empty window

ul.li: Plays MP3, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, WAV, AAC/M4A, AIFF and other common audio formats
Drop songs or folders on the window to build a playlist; folders are added with their subfolders, in numbered order (track 2 comes before track 10)
"Add whole folder" adds the other songs from the playing song's folder around it, in folder order, so playback continues with the next file
Double-clicking a song in the file manager opens it in an idle Easy Player window, or in a new window if the open one is busy
Starting a song in one window pauses the others
Keyboard media keys and the desktop's media controls (MPRIS) work with the player that started playing last
Repeat can be off, all or one; volume and repeat mode are kept between sessions
Keyboard shortcuts: Space to play or pause, Left and Right arrows to skip 5 seconds, Enter to play the selected song, Delete to remove it, Ctrl+O to add files
Right-click a song to play it, add the rest of its folder, show it in the file manager or remove it from the playlist
Available as a Flatpak from the hwnhub channel
